title: Treatise on Breaking the Line
summary: A treatise on cracking a shield line apart with a wedge of qi, from gap-reading to holding the breach open.

title: The Heavy Cavalry Lance Canon
summary: A canon for armored lancers teaching cuirass-breaking drives and a charge strong enough to unhorse a rider.

title: Principles of the Long Couched Point
summary: Principles for Xiantian lancers who extend a qi field beyond the iron so the thrust lands early.

title: Lance Doctrine for the Wheeling Charge
summary: A doctrine of the curved approach, striking from a wheel and closing a spiral on the enemy's flank.

title: Twin Lances of the Basin Court
summary: Teaches two riders to couch lances side by side, matching strides and striking as one wedge.

title: The Hawk's Stoop: A Lance Manual
summary: A manual of the downward dive stroke, teaching Xiantian riders to fall on a target from above.

title: River Ford Lance Charges
summary: Teaches charges through shallow water and the holding of a narrow ford against crossing riders.

title: Lance Along the Wind-Bearing
summary: Teaches riders to take a bearing in the wind and lay the lance along it with gusts behind the point.

title: The Plateau Rider's Oath Lance
summary: Teaches plateau riders to hold an oath-sworn line across open ground with the lance and a qi field.

title: Gale-Borne Lance: Charges Without Walls
summary: Teaches charges across open plain, riding the gale to scatter foes who have nothing to hide behind.
